overview.description: The PGIM S&P 500 Quarterly Buffer 15 ETF (PQXV) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in downside hedge alternatives. The fund aims for specific buffered losses and capped gains on the SPDR S&P 500 ETF Trust over three months. The actively managed fund holds options and collateral. PQXV was launched on Jun 30, 2026 and is issued by PGIM.
